listenerReplies: You said the wall is configuration — which single setup step feels most skippable before someone sees their first real result?

analystCandidates.text: Which onboarding step could you defer until after the first real result?
Showing value before setup quietly flips the usual order of trust.

seedTranscript: So I've been thinking about why our onboarding drops off.
I think the issue is we ask for too much before showing any value.
What if we flipped it — let them see one real result first, then ask for the setup?
